mechanic.1: Tap a mirror to turn it 90°. Guide the light to the target!
mechanic.2: There are several mirrors. Plan the beam's path from the start.
mechanic.3: Walls stop the light. Mirrors with a dark frame are fixed and don't turn.
mechanic.4: Colored sources! Each target wants light in the color of its ring. Red + green = yellow.
mechanic.5: Color filters only let their own color through. White light that passes through a filter takes on its color.
mechanic.6: A prism splits light. Relative to the beam's DIRECTION OF TRAVEL, red turns left, green goes straight and blue turns right: on a beam going down, red ends up on the right of the screen.
mechanic.7: There are several targets. They all have to light up at the same time to finish the level.
mechanic.8: Gold blocks stop the light. Drag one to slide it by one square.
mechanic.9: When the light hits a key, the door of the same color opens.
mechanic.10: All the mechanics together. Show that you're a true Light Master!

privacy.ads: Ads: When an internet connection is available, ads are shown through Google AdMob. Google may process data such as the advertising ID, device and app information, approximate location (estimated from the IP address) and ad interactions to serve ads, measure them and prevent abuse. Details: policies.google.com/technologies/ads
privacy.children: Children: The game is intended for a general audience; ad content is limited to "PG".
privacy.consent: Consent: In regions where it is required (e.g. the EU, the UK), Google's consent form is shown before ads; in those regions you can change your choice with "Ad Privacy Options" in Settings. You can reset or delete your advertising ID in your device's Settings > Privacy > Ads.
privacy.delete: Settings > Reset Progress deletes your progress, in-game currency and items. Uninstalling the app deletes all of the game's data from the device; you can delete the copy in your Android backup in your Google account's backup settings.
privacy.intro: {0} is a puzzle game. The game itself doesn't ask you to create an account, doesn't ask for personal data and doesn't send data to us. Your progress, settings, lives and the in-game items you buy are stored on your device. If Android backup is turned on, this data can also be included in your own Google account backup and restored on a new device; we have no access to that backup.
privacy.rewarded: Rewarded videos are optional. The game is fully playable without an internet connection.
privacy.title: Privacy Policy
settings.about_local: Your progress is saved on your device (and in your Android backup, if it's on).
settings.about_offline: You can play offline. When you're online, ads are shown through Google AdMob; watching videos is optional.
settings.reset_body: All your stars, unlocked levels, daily streak, achievements, crystals, Prism Gems, boosters and skins will be deleted. This can't be undone.

tutorial.lives_text.one: Each level gives you a limited number of moves (LEFT, top right). Undo doesn't give moves back. Your first move uses 1 life, which you get back when you finish the level; you lose it if you run out of moves, restart or quit. You get a new life every {0} minute.
tutorial.lives_text.other: Each level gives you a limited number of moves (LEFT, top right). Undo doesn't give moves back. Your first move uses 1 life, which you get back when you finish the level; you lose it if you run out of moves, restart or quit. You get a new life every {0} minutes.

tutorial.rotate_text: Tap the mirrors with a turquoise ring: each tap turns the mirror 90°. Mirrors in dark bolted slots are fixed and don't turn.
tutorial.stars_text: Finish in the fewest moves to earn 3 stars. If you get stuck, Hint shows you the next correct move (or tells you to Undo first).
tutorial.welcome_text: Guide the beam from the light source to the target ring. The level is complete when every target lights up. Walls stop the light.
